query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tobacco_cigarettes (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  brand_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  alternate_names VARCHAR(255),
  origin_country VARCHAR(100),
  origin_city VARCHAR(100),
  manufacturer VARCHAR(200),
  creation_year INT,
  discontinuation_year INT,
  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'rare', 'unknown') DEFAULT 'unknown',
  format VARCHAR(100),
  has_filter BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  tobacco_blend TEXT,
  aromatic_intensity INT,
  aromatic_character TEXT,
  dominant_notes TEXT,
  secondary_notes TEXT,
  perfumery_potential_score DECIMAL(3,1),
  perfumery_applications TEXT,
  perfumery_approach TEXT,
  historical_price VARCHAR(100),
  historical_notes TEXT,
  cultural_significance TEXT,
  region_category ENUM('soviet', 'oriental', 'chinese', 'european', 'american', 'other') DEFAULT 'other',
  source_references TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
